create_project_instance: create a Project instance from a dictionary of Prolific API project data fields
validate_project_schema: validate a Project instance against the JSON schema to check required fields and types
project_to_dict: convert a Project instance to a plain dictionary using the to_dict method
project_str_repr: get a human-readable string representation of a Project showing its class name, id, and title
review_project_schema: review the Project schema definition to understand required fields like title and optional fields like naivety_distribution_rate
